protocol.confirmation_source: Owner instructions in the active chat, 2026-10-17: "fix the kit to Missing Column, Counted (not trailer)", then "Rewrite the criterion. Do not keep the trailer, and do not keep the shared-misses criterion on Counted." Supersedes the earlier trailer selection and the shared-misses task.
protocol.film_selection: The Missing Column, Counted (the census film, 40 s). It shows that most examined public evaluations do not record what happened to both guards on the same item: 14 of 20 lack the joint column, 5 of 20 keep some joint evidence, 0 at matched thresholds with full exposure. The film task tests that, not the shared-misses construction, which this film does not show.

rater_criteria.subject: the answer identifies AI guardrails and the question of their shared failures, combined misses, or what separate scores leave unknown. Equivalent plain language counts. A generic answer such as “an AI website” is insufficient.
rater_criteria.contact: the reader identifies the owner's working email link/address on the homepage. They need not send email. The homepage task passes only if both subject and contact succeed within the same 20-second window.
rater_criteria.missing_column: the sentence states both parts. (1) What is missing: the joint record, meaning what happened to both guards on the same item (equivalently, the joint column or joint evidence). (2) The scale: most evaluations lack it, or 14 of 20 lack it, or only 5 of 20 keep any. Exact numbers and specialist terms are unnecessary. Passing examples: “Most evaluations don't record what happened to both guards on the same item.” “14 out of 20 evaluations don't have the joint column.” “Only 5 of 20 keep any joint evidence, none at matched thresholds.” Failing examples: “Guards fail together sometimes.” (no joint record, no scale; could be said without watching). “Individual scores don't tell you how often guards fail together.” (true, but it is the shared-misses answer, not what this film counts). “The film was about AI safety.” (no content). An answer missing either part fails.
rater_criteria.proof: one actual activation of the real post-player proof link reaches `/try/`. An instruction, a visible URL, or a facilitator's click is not a completed task.

protocol.limits: Exactly five distinct unfamiliar humans. Human authenticity, unfamiliarity and raw-answer fidelity are facilitator attestations; automation cannot verify them. The film explanation and proof task have no time cutoff.
